Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# task-97526768: fill outlined interiors

For this task, locate every closed rectangular frame on the uniform background. Fill its interior (strictly between the border cells) according to the interior dimensions: use color 7 when both interior side lengths are odd, and color 2 when both are even. All observed frames are squares; for a non-square frame or mismatched parity, request evidence rather than extrapolating. Preserve frame cells, exterior background, and unrelated content. The fill depends on geometry, not outline color. Examples: 1x1, 3x3, and 5x5 interiors became 7; 2x2 and 4x4 interiors became 2.

## Confirmed evidence
- Demo pair 1: background 4, a 7x7 frame with 5x5 interior yielded fill 7 (odd side length).
- Demo pair 2: background 8. Frames with 6x6 and 4x4 interiors yielded fill 7; frames with 2x2 interiors yielded fill 2. This confirms the parity rule on 2x2, 4x4, and 6x6 interiors.
- Demo pair 3: background 8. A 3x3 frame with 1x1 interior and a 5x5 frame with 3x3 interior yielded fill 7; a 6x6 frame with 4x4 interior yielded fill 2.
- Accepted test (background 3): a color-5 5x5 frame and color-6 3x3 frame were filled 7; a color-4 8x8 frame was filled 2; the lower-right color-5 5x5 frame was filled 7. These correspond respectively to interior sizes 3x3, 1x1, 6x6, and 3x3. Preserve all frames, background, and unrelated cells.

Coordinates are zero-indexed. Detect actual closed frame bounds; don't hard-code dimensions or outline color. Use interior dimensions, not outer dimensions: if both side lengths are odd, fill 7; if both are even, fill 2. Evidence directly confirms square frames with odd interiors 1, 3, 5 and even interiors 2, 4, 6. Non-square / mixed-parity case is not established. Keep borders and all exterior/unrelated cells unchanged. Validate output dimensions and row widths before submission.
